items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: I freelance with a lot of different people as a sideman with Mulgrew Miller, James Williams, Buster Williams

ctx.x: What other kinds of gigs come your way?

Well let’s see. I freelance with a lot of different people as a sideman with Mulgrew Miller, James Williams, Buster Williams, various things in town, in New York I mean, either subbing for someone on a big band or working with other people in recording dates. I’m doing some teaching these days. So it’s pretty diversified. I’m jumping all over the place. I was in Dayton, Ohio a week ago doing a residency there as part of their arts program and actually doing a concert with the quartet in March. I’ll be going out…
We had mentioned the IAJE thing and it seems like it’s almost a necessity these days for jazz musicians to get involved in the education scene.
